description: Historical split_v1 placed zero Grade 2 samples in test set.
Unconstrained cutpoint biases inverted across random seeds, creating negative probabilities.
100.0% AUROC claim was derived from synthetic Gaussian vectors rather than real images.
Raw inverse frequency weighting created a 175:1 weight ratio, causing false Grade 2 explosions.
Out-of-range or negative species IDs caused runtime index errors or silently corrupted embeddings.
High test accuracy (~92%) was driven by turntable studio images (fruits360); real bin accuracy collapsed to ~46%.
Historical claim that species embeddings improve grading was contradicted by 30-seed confirmatory study.
